Dartas

Biography

Dartas is the baron’s son and expects to inherit Jigran. His early arrogance and boredom give way to despair as the family’s military position deteriorates. Kir’s resolve wins his trust. His recollection of a blue-stoned medallion and a village destroyed by harpies also provides a lead to Joon relics. [1, 2, 3]
